adaptations: React hook state becomes a synchronous Rust controller; replaceable host actions are supplied on each call so stale render callbacks cannot be retained.
OpenTUI focus callbacks map to Ratatui keyboard ownership and the modal composer intercepts input until save or cancel returns focus to review navigation.
Workdeck's semantic terminal draft and stored-note models remain authoritative; the composer only projects public extension event values.

Previously inert Edit and Reply commands now open real native composers, preserve the edited note id or reply parent id, mutate the authoritative review state, and publish the matching lifecycle event.
